reports.details: almost perfect, some issues with particle effects and boss bars but everything else works

It loads and items are added, but applying a biome does not work. Item icons do not seem to have a dynamic color of the biome ID applied, either. (Note: the mod has a 1.8 version too which works a bit differently (and in my opinion is better), but I did not try that one since if I understand 1.8 isn't necessarily supported right now.)
